title: Reproducibility package for Evaluating image embeddings and metadata for NFT price prediction using temporal validation
description: Version 4.1.0 contains pseudonymized evaluation targets, grouping information and aligned predictions for recomputation of primary and October 2026 sensitivity-analysis metrics and confidence intervals. Includes executed source, development-selection records, access instructions and integrity checks. Local verification reproduced 9,550 numeric entries across 12 result tables. This is fixed-prediction numerical replay; raw third-party inputs and full refitting are outside its scope. Source code is licensed under MIT; excluded third-party materials are not relicensed.
